extension.summary: CU LRC Lyrics, fork with OK/OSD, sync, and scraper reliability fixes
extension.description: Fork of CU LRC Lyrics 6.7.1 (original by Taxigps/ronie, https://gitlab.com/ronie/script.cu.lrclyrics/) with several fixes applied on top: (1) the OK button on the remote no longer gets swallowed by the lyrics dialog's stolen input focus, and pressing OK now shows the music OSD/menu, with the lyrics view automatically reopening afterwards instead of requiring a full navigation reset; (2) manual sync offset correction (up/down during timed lyrics) restored after that same focus change had silently broken it, opening a dedicated on-screen slider; left/right seeks the track (10s/30s/1min with rapid-repeat acceleration, like Kodi's video OSD) with its own transient progress-bar overlay showing position/elapsed/total time, and the lyric line now immediately follows any seek instead of catching up several seconds later; (3) plain (untimed) txt lyrics no longer get stuck showing only the first line forever; (4) several scraper reliability fixes - a crash in the lrclib.net scraper that could silently abort the entire remaining fallback chain, a Music163 false-positive that returned songwriter-credit-only text as if it were real lyrics, and duration-aware filtering so a title/artist match to a different edit (radio edit, remix, extended version) gets rejected instead of producing badly out-of-sync lyrics. Automatically disables the original script.cu.lrclyrics on startup if found installed and enabled, since the two conflict as lyrics service. Optional on-demand lyrics translation via DeepL (off by default, needs your own API key) is available from the context menu, shown in an on-screen panel whose skin patch (see script.xderecx.aeonnox5lyricsfix) has only been tested on Aeon Nox 5 - other skins will still get working lyrics, but the translation panel and topbar fix need that skin. A single "Interface & translation language" setting (English/Español/Deutsch/Slovenčina/Čeština) picks both this add-on's own menus/notifications and the default lyrics translation target - independent of Kodi's own system language. See this repository's README and the version history below for details.
extension.summary: CU LRC Lyrics, fork s opravami OK/OSD, synchronizace a spolehlivosti stahovačů
extension.description: Fork CU LRC Lyrics 6.7.1 (originál od Taxigps/ronie, https://gitlab.com/ronie/script.cu.lrclyrics/) s několika opravami navíc: (1) tlačítko OK na dálkovém ovladači už nepohltí ukradené zaměření dialogu s textem písně a stisknutí OK nyní zobrazí hudební OSD/menu, přičemž se zobrazení textu poté automaticky znovu otevře, místo aby vyžadovalo úplný reset navigace; (2) ruční korekce synchronizačního posunu (nahoru/dolů během časovaného textu) obnovena poté, co ji stejná změna zaměření tiše rozbila - nyní otevírá vlastní posuvník na obrazovce; doleva/doprava přetáčí skladbu (10 s/30 s/1 min se zrychlením při rychlém opakovaném stisku, podobně jako video OSD v Kodi) s vlastním dočasným překryvem s ukazatelem průběhu zobrazujícím pozici/uplynulý/celkový čas, a řádek textu nyní okamžitě následuje jakékoli přetočení místo dohánění o několik sekund později; (3) obyčejný (nečasovaný) TXT text už neuvízne navždy na zobrazení jen první řádky; (4) několik oprav spolehlivosti stahovačů - pád ve stahovači lrclib.net, který mohl tiše přerušit celý zbývající řetězec záložních zdrojů, falešně pozitivní výsledek Music163, který vracel pouze řádky s autorskými zásluhami jako by šlo o skutečný text, a filtrování podle délky skladby, takže shoda názvu/interpreta s jinou verzí (rádiová edice, remix, prodloužená verze) je odmítnuta místo toho, aby vznikl špatně synchronizovaný text. Při spuštění automaticky vypne původní script.cu.lrclyrics, pokud je nainstalovaný a povolený, protože oba doplňky si konkurují jako služba pro texty písní. Volitelný překlad textů na vyžádání přes DeepL (ve výchozím stavu vypnutý, vyžaduje vlastní API klíč) je dostupný z kontextové nabídky a zobrazuje se v panelu na obrazovce, jehož úprava skinu (viz script.xderecx.aeonnox5lyricsfix) byla testována pouze na Aeon Nox 5 - ostatní skiny budou mít funkční texty písní i tak, ale panel s překladem a oprava horní lišty vyžadují tento skin. Jedno nastavení "Jazyk rozhraní a překladu" (English/Español/Deutsch/Slovenčina/Čeština) určuje jak jazyk vlastních menu/oznámení doplňku, tak výchozí cílový jazyk překladu textů - nezávisle na systémovém jazyce Kodi. Podrobnosti najdete v README tohoto repozitáře a v historii verzí níže.
extension.summary: CU LRC Lyrics, Fork mit Korrekturen für OK/OSD, Synchronisation und Quellenzuverlässigkeit
extension.description: Fork von CU LRC Lyrics 6.7.1 (Original von Taxigps/ronie, https://gitlab.com/ronie/script.cu.lrclyrics/) mit mehreren zusätzlichen Korrekturen: (1) die OK-Taste der Fernbedienung wird nicht mehr vom gestohlenen Eingabefokus des Songtext-Dialogs verschluckt, und ein Druck auf OK zeigt nun das Musik-OSD/Menü an, wobei die Songtextansicht danach automatisch wieder geöffnet wird, statt einen kompletten Navigations-Reset zu erfordern; (2) manuelle Synchronisationskorrektur (Hoch/Runter während zeitgesteuerter Songtexte) wiederhergestellt, nachdem dieselbe Fokusänderung sie stillschweigend kaputt gemacht hatte - öffnet jetzt einen eigenen Schieberegler auf dem Bildschirm; Links/Rechts spult den Titel (10 s/30 s/1 min mit Beschleunigung bei schnell wiederholtem Drücken, wie beim Video-OSD von Kodi) mit einer eigenen kurzzeitigen Fortschrittsbalken-Einblendung, die Position/verstrichene/Gesamtzeit anzeigt, und die Songtextzeile folgt jetzt sofort jedem Spulen, statt erst nach mehreren Sekunden aufzuholen; (3) einfache (nicht zeitgesteuerte) TXT-Songtexte bleiben nicht mehr für immer bei der ersten Zeile hängen; (4) mehrere Zuverlässigkeitskorrekturen bei den Quellen - ein Absturz im lrclib.net-Scraper, der die gesamte restliche Fallback-Kette stillschweigend abbrechen konnte, ein Music163-Fehlalarm, der reine Textdichter-/Komponisten-Credit-Zeilen als echten Songtext zurückgab, und eine längenbasierte Filterung, sodass eine Titel-/Interpreten-Übereinstimmung mit einer anderen Version (Radioedit, Remix, Extended Version) abgelehnt wird, statt schlecht synchronisierten Songtext zu erzeugen. Deaktiviert beim Start automatisch das ursprüngliche script.cu.lrclyrics, falls installiert und aktiviert, da beide als Songtext-Dienst in Konflikt stehen. Eine optionale Songtext-Übersetzung auf Abruf via DeepL (standardmäßig deaktiviert, benötigt einen eigenen API-Schlüssel) ist über das Kontextmenü verfügbar und wird in einem Bildschirmpanel angezeigt, dessen Skin-Patch (siehe script.xderecx.aeonnox5lyricsfix) nur mit Aeon Nox 5 getestet wurde - andere Skins erhalten trotzdem funktionierende Songtexte, aber das Übersetzungspanel und die Titelleisten-Korrektur benötigen diesen Skin. Eine einzige Einstellung "Oberflächen- und Übersetzungssprache" (English/Español/Deutsch/Slovenčina/Čeština) legt sowohl die Sprache der eigenen Menüs/Benachrichtigungen dieses Add-ons als auch die Standard-Zielsprache der Songtext-Übersetzung fest - unabhängig von der Systemsprache von Kodi. Details siehe README dieses Repositorys und die Versionshistorie unten.
extension.summary: CU LRC Lyrics, fork con correcciones de OK/OSD, sincronización y fiabilidad de buscadores
extension.description: Fork de CU LRC Lyrics 6.7.1 (original de Taxigps/ronie, https://gitlab.com/ronie/script.cu.lrclyrics/) con varias correcciones añadidas: (1) el botón OK del mando ya no queda absorbido por el foco de entrada robado del diálogo de la letra, y al pulsar OK ahora se muestra el OSD/menú de música, reabriéndose después automáticamente la vista de la letra en lugar de requerir un reinicio completo de la navegación; (2) se restauró la corrección manual del desfase de sincronización (Arriba/Abajo durante letras sincronizadas) después de que ese mismo cambio de foco la rompiera silenciosamente, abriendo ahora un control deslizante propio en pantalla; Izquierda/Derecha avanza o retrocede la canción (10 s/30 s/1 min con aceleración al pulsar repetidamente, como el OSD de vídeo de Kodi) con su propia superposición temporal de barra de progreso que muestra posición/tiempo transcurrido/tiempo total, y la línea de la letra ahora sigue el avance o retroceso de inmediato en lugar de ponerse al día varios segundos después; (3) las letras TXT normales (sin sincronizar) ya no se quedan atascadas mostrando solo la primera línea para siempre; (4) varias correcciones de fiabilidad en los buscadores - un fallo en el buscador lrclib.net que podía interrumpir silenciosamente toda la cadena de alternativas restante, un falso positivo de Music163 que devolvía líneas de créditos de autoría como si fueran la letra real, y un filtrado según la duración para que una coincidencia de título/artista con una edición distinta (edición de radio, remix, versión extendida) se rechace en lugar de producir una letra mal sincronizada. Desactiva automáticamente el script.cu.lrclyrics original al iniciar si está instalado y activado, ya que ambos entran en conflicto como servicio de letras. La traducción de letras opcional bajo demanda mediante DeepL (desactivada por defecto, necesita tu propia clave de API) está disponible desde el menú contextual y se muestra en un panel en pantalla cuyo parche de skin (ver script.xderecx.aeonnox5lyricsfix) solo se ha probado con Aeon Nox 5 - otros skins seguirán teniendo letras funcionales, pero el panel de traducción y la corrección de la barra superior necesitan ese skin. Un único ajuste "Idioma de interfaz y traducción" (English/Español/Deutsch/Slovenčina/Čeština) elige tanto el idioma de los propios menús/notificaciones de este complemento como el idioma de destino predeterminado para la traducción de letras - independientemente del idioma del sistema de Kodi. Consulta el README de este repositorio y el historial de versiones a continuación para más detalles.
extension.news: 1.13.2: updated the one-time first-timed-lyrics tip notification (string #32012), which only ever mentioned Up/Down sync and was now stale since 1.10.0 added Left/Right seek - now mentions both. 1.13.1: widened the lyrics sync-offset slider range (context menu "Sync", or up/down on timed lyrics) from ±20s to ±30s. 1.13.0: skip translating lyrics into English when they're already in English (target language = English only) - a cheap stopword-frequency heuristic (lib/translate.py looks_like_english(), not a real language detector) avoids burning DeepL/Google/Lingva quota on a no-op translation, for both manual "Show translation" and "sticky" auto-translate on a new track. Only applied for an English target, since the same short-circuit for the other 4 languages would need a reliable stopword list per language to do safely without risking skipping a translation that was actually needed. 1.12.0: new unified "Interface & translation language" setting (English default, plus Español/Deutsch/Slovenčina/Čeština) - one choice now drives both this add-on's own menus/notifications/dialogs (via a new lib/localization.py that reads the matching resources/language/resource.language.xx_yy/strings.po directly, independent of Kodi's own system language) and the default lyrics translation target language, replacing the old separate free-text translate_lang setting (previously constrained to sk/cs only). Added full cs_CZ, es_ES and de_DE translations (sk_SK and en_GB already existed) plus matching addon.xml description/summary entries for Kodi's Add-ons browser (that part still follows Kodi's system language, a Kodi limitation - only this add-on's own runtime strings follow the new setting). 1.11.2: fixed a real bug - the highlighted lyric line did not reliably follow a seek (either left/right or clicking a line to jump to it). refresh() only ever reschedules its own timer for the NEXT line boundary, computed from the position BEFORE the seek, so the display kept following the pre-seek timeline until that stale timer happened to fire on its own, which could take several seconds and looked like lyrics not reacting to seeking at all. Both seek paths now force an immediate stop_refresh()+refresh() right after seekTime() instead of waiting on the stale timer. 1.11.1: bumped script.xderecx.aeonnox5lyricsfix requirement to 1.5.0 for the repositioned/widened seek overlay (no library code change). 1.11.0: left/right seek now shows a transient progress-bar overlay (position on the full track timeline, elapsed/total time, and the +/-10s/30s/1:00 amount just seeked) matching Kodi's own video seek OSD style, auto-hiding after ~1.5s of no further presses - since this dialog swallows the native seek OSD entirely, seeking previously gave no visual feedback at all about where it landed. Requires script.xderecx.aeonnox5lyricsfix 1.3.0+ for the new skin controls. 1.10.0: large batch of translation and sync fixes. Translation: added a direct Google Translate fallback tier (DeepL to Google to Lingva) since it's the same engine Lingva proxies but doesn't depend on a specific public instance's uptime; translation is now "sticky" for the rest of the session once turned on - a new song reuses its cache or fetches a fresh one automatically, same as pressing "Show translation" manually; a cached Google/Lingva result gets upgraded to DeepL automatically once a DeepL key is available again; the translation panel now fills in progressively as each line arrives instead of staying blank for 20-30s on the Google/Lingva per-line fallback (and this now also correctly finishes for DeepL's single batch call, which was a real bug - the panel used to get stuck showing the original untranslated text until a full reopen); context menu label now toggles between "Show translation" and "Hide translation" instead of always reading the same regardless of state; missing Slovak strings.po entries for the last few versions' new strings (was silently falling back to English) are filled in. Sync offset: fixed a real bug where the offset appeared to reset after the OK/OSD reopen or a next-track change - self.syncadjust is now the single source of truth (read directly from the lyrics file's own [offset:N] tag every time, instead of being split between that tag and a separately-tracked live delta that only one of two code paths knew about); the sync slider now runs in its own dedicated skin window (see script.xderecx.aeonnox5lyricsfix 1.2.0) instead of the shared DialogSlider.xml also used for volume/seek/brightness elsewhere in Kodi. Other: a fast local .lrc lookup could lose a race against the previous song's GUI thread still cleaning up, silently skipping showing lyrics (and therefore translation) entirely until a manual OK/OSD reopen forced a retry - now waits up to ~2s for that cleanup instead of giving up immediately; left/right on the remote now seeks the track (this dialog was swallowing all input, including the seek that normally works with no dialog open at all), with the same rapid-repeat acceleration as Kodi's video seek OSD (10s / 30s / 60s). 1.9.0: translation now falls back to a free Lingva Translate instance (no key needed, auto-detects source language) when no DeepL key is set, or when DeepL fails/runs out of its one-time character credit - previously it just showed an error in that case. The Lingva instance used is configurable in settings in case the default (lingva.ml) goes down. 1.8.0: added an optional, off-by-default lyrics translation feature (context menu "Show translation") using the DeepL API - requires an API key set in this addon's settings. On-demand only (never fetched automatically per song, to avoid burning API quota on tracks you don't care about), and the result is cached as a plain text file alongside the addon's own saved lyrics so it's only translated once per song. 1.7.0: now declares script.xderecx.aeonnox5lyricsfix as a real add-on dependency, so Kodi installs it automatically alongside this one instead of it being an easy-to-miss separate manual step - it still needs to be run once from Program add-ons to actually patch the skin (can't auto-patch a third-party skin without the user's OK). Also now auto-disables the original script.cu.lrclyrics on every Kodi startup if it's found installed and enabled, since the two can't both run as the lyrics service - previously this conflict had to be resolved manually. 1.6.0: up/down during timed lyrics now opens the same on-screen slider dialog used by the context menu's "Sync" option, instead of silently nudging a hidden offset and popping a "Sync offset: +0.5s" notification that didn't say which direction was which. The slider dialog has a static "LATER <---- SYNC OFFSET ----> EARLIER" legend plus a live readout ("Lyrics play Xs earlier/later"/"In sync"), auto-closes after 4s of no input, and the slider step matches the old 0.5s nudge. 1.5.2: clear the previous song's lyrics from the screen immediately on song change, instead of leaving the old lyrics visible for the few seconds get_lyrics() can take to run scraper lookups for the new song. 1.5.1: fixed the same native Kodi crash as 1.5.0 recurring, because 1.5.0 only excluded the ".offset(N)" + "MusicPlayer.Duration" combination while the next-song lyrics prefetch (Song.next(), added for the duration-aware filtering in 1.4.0) still queried Title/Artist/Lyrics/Property with ".offset(1)" - it turns out any MusicPlayer/Player info label combined with ".offset(N)" is unsafe on this Kodi build, not just Duration. Song.next() is now disabled entirely (returns None) instead of trying to fix each individual label one crash at a time - prefetching next-song lyrics was a minor head-start optimization, not essential, since lyrics still get fetched reactively the moment the next track actually starts. 1.5.0: fixed a Kodi crash (native SIGSEGV inside CGUIInfoManager::GetMultiInfoLabel, called via xbmc.getInfoLabel from Python) observed shortly after Song.by_offset() queried "MusicPlayer.offset(N).Duration" for the prefetched next-song lookup added in 1.4.0's duration-aware filtering. That exact info label combination (Duration + a non-zero offset) is far less established than plain "MusicPlayer.Duration", so duration is now only fetched for the current song (offset 0) rather than trying to root-cause a native crash inside Kodi itself. 1.4.0: restored manual lyrics sync correction - the old scrolltosync() feature relied on the lyrics list having native focus (self.controlId == 110) to read a manually-navigated line's timestamp, which was dead code ever since focus was disabled in 1.0.0 for the OK-button/OSD fix, so up/down did nothing for out-of-sync (but correct-edit) timed lyrics. Up/down during timed lyrics now directly nudges a saved offset (with an on-screen readout) instead of depending on focus. Also added duration-aware filtering to the lrclib and musixmatchlrc scrapers so a title/artist match to a different edit (radio edit, remix, extended version) with a different length is rejected instead of producing badly out-of-sync lyrics. 1.3.0: fixed plain (untimed) txt lyrics getting stuck showing only the first line forever - a regression from the 1.0.0 OK-button/OSD fix, which disabled focus on the lyrics list so onFocus() (and the up/down scroll handling that depended on it) never fired. Timed LRC lyrics were unaffected since those auto-scroll via a timer regardless of focus. Up/down now moves the txt lyrics selection directly. 1.2.0: fixed a false-positive match in the Music163 scraper - it sometimes only has songwriter/composer credit lines in its lyric DB (e.g. "作词 : ..." / "作曲 : ...") with no actual lyrics, but returned them as if they were valid, blocking the real Genius/musixmatch result from being tried. Now checks the returned lyric actually has content beyond credit lines. 1.1.0: fixed a bug where the lrclib.net scraper could crash with an uncaught TypeError when the API returned an unexpected (non-list) response, which silently aborted the entire remaining lyrics search cascade (musixmatch, genius, supermusic, etc. never got tried). The lrclib scraper is now defensive against bad responses, and both scraper loops in gui.py now catch exceptions per-provider so one broken source can no longer block the rest. 1.0.0: fork of upstream 6.7.1. Fixed OK button being swallowed by lyrics dialog focus; OK now shows OSD and lyrics auto-resume when OSD closes.
